company_info.company_description: " With over a decade of experience in the industry, our mission is to provide South Australians with high quality and innovative systems at competitive prices.We pride ourselves on our high standard of installations and materials used, and offer quality workmanship every time. Our professional tradespeople are trained, licensed and reliable.As experts in both solar and air conditioning, we provide:Design and system recommendations to best suit your individual circumstances.Fully qualified, licenced and accredited installers.Quality installations with a 10- year guarantee on workmanship.Solutions for both residential and commercial properties.$10,000,000 public liability insurance coverage.Warranties on all our products, and only select the best systems available from the big name brands.Financing solutions to fit in with your budget.Quality solar panels with a 25- year output warranty guaranteed."

reviews.review_description: Sales and and quotation was very goodThe actual installation was faultless,tidy,punctual and discussed in a friendly manner.The sales person did not have a great handle on positioning of the battery unit.They are yet to show us how to use the charger and app which I assume will happen when the system is finally up and runningWe did have some holdups getting Sigen to change our contact details to my partner who does all our admin
Very happy with all aspects of installation.Despite encountering a few problems installation was completed quickly and efficientlyWatching the production of energy via the app is adding to the joy.

Quoting process was simple - really took the time to answer questions, assess the site in person, and willing to price match.Install was arranged quickly and went smoothly. Team did a great job, showed me how to download and use the app, and meter swap over all arranged.Very happy with the new system.

From the moment we decided to go with EnergySA the process was smooth & seamless.Robby contacted us within a few days and arranged a site visit, letting us know the pros & cons of the various solar panel & inverter combinations. He provided three quotes for the various options, while maximising our solar system size for our difficult roof style.Once we selected a quote, the installation date was booked, all required paperwork raised & smart meter installed all within a couple of weeks.The installation crew arrived on time, were well spoken, polite and respectful, we had limited spare tiles and the tradesmen were very good and only needed to use a couple. Considering the number of tiles that needed grinding down and drilling through, this was a fantastic result.The installation was done to a terrific standard, with a tidy and professional finish. They took the time to explain everything and to setup the monitoring App etc.The follow up customer service was second to none, Courtney sent through all the related product & warranty documents and followed up to check we were happy with everything.
Answered everything I needed to know. Went through and explained everything clearly, made sure that I understood what would happen on the day.

My property was a relatively difficult challenge , 2 story, small roof,(we had a few "job's too hard" companies) however Robbie was excellent at assessing our requirements and providing a technical solution. He provided  production and energy independence figures, currently we are exceeding these. The installation was very smooth and the team did a great job, including tidying up. Connection and commissioning was very smooth. The after sales customer service has been excellent so far. I had a couple of non-standard requests, which they responded to promptly. Communication throughout the entire process was excellent.

Installer was very good and didn’t seem to rush the work. The after sales customer service is also excellent. They reached out to my energy provider to get everything sorted prior to installation. Customer service helped me connect to the app to see the solar working. Been using it now for more than a month and my projected quarterly bill from my energy provider app has significantly decreased l.
Very knowledgeable salesperson Addie, and I was particularly impressed with the installers great bunch of guys.
Bird netting & inverter cover included. Installed in one day including removal of our faulty panels
EnergySA were great to work with. Very informative and straight forward. Not pushy, just precise info and helpful options.

Nothing was too much trouble even when I changed my mind about the products I decided on. Friendly, professional, quick responses, actually came to my home without having to ask and was keen to do so. Robby who sold me the system explained everything well and easily and nothing was a hassle. I am keen to have work done right the first time and Robby made sure the team who installed the system were aware and the boys who did the install were friendly and professional and discussed things with me through the day, showed me the completed stages and cleaned up after themselves, I can’t thank them enough for taking the time and being thorough with their work. I highly recommend them to anyone thinking of solar. Thanks again to a great team and local SA business.

I am glad I had people come to my property to provide a quote rather than pushy telephone salesmen. The salesman was punctual, friendly and knowledgeable. The installers were punctual, polite and efficient. They cleaned up after themselves and kept me informed during the installation. It all went smoothly and they organised everything.
Thanks to solar quotes, I was educated on solar and this made the quoting process much betterInstallation went wellWas sub contracted from the people I dealt with during the quoting

Was looking to replacing my existing 3Kw solar system as it was not producing enough to cover our power bills.Had many companies quote and provide recommendations, Energy SA stood out from the pack. From the moment Sam came to visit and ran through my options I knew I had found the company I was looking for. he explained the option in terms I could easily comprehend. we ended up going with a 13kw system with the Alpha Battery and we love it. the online interface is easy to understand and a great way to keep an eye on the system. our first bill when from $900+ this time last year to a -$300 credit.

Energy SA provided lots of patient and detailed advice when providing quotes, and were happy to adjust our panel layout to ensure the panels were as discreet as possible. They also handled all the connection and rebate paperwork for us which made the process much easier than I anticipated.The installation team were efficient and careful, and the final result is very tidy. I was particularly grateful that the installers were willing to wear face masks while inside my home, because I am immune compromised.

Paul was extremely helpful during the design process and followed up afterwards.They removed our existing system about 2 days prior to installing the new one.The installation was done in about half a day. Thorough testing and cleanup completed afterwards. All paperwork for our energy provider and SA Power Networks was done by them, with very little input required by us.

I had most pleasant experience with EnergySA. Sam Carey is a *the* guru of solar technology in SA. Every staff who worked in EnergySA was very supportive and helpful but what really set these guys apart is how knowledgeable they were. I got my system nearly 2 years ago and Sam and I spent hours trying to optimise every inch of our roof. He ran hypothetical scenarios, did the math, and really present a succinct and a very well laid-out information. I felt informed and educated and he worked with me to create the solar that I wanted.I rang around to other several big names (and some small ones) and I can guarentuee none has the expertise and the support of EnergySA and Sam. These guys know what they are doing, and they work with you specifically, not some template off their cheatsheets. Look no further.
All went well except that they only discovered a mounting problem when they were actually ready to install battery, but then they solved it satisfactorily

It was on the solar quotes list but not a recommendation. They have humm finance which I have used before and has no interest on it. Was the best price for the biggest system. Install time is slow and hasn't happened yet as the next available install day was a few months but it works fine for us.
Good sales, install was good, good clean up after job

Our salesperson Robbie was super helpful and explained all the ins and outs of the solar options. His product knowledge is vast and knew exactly how and what we’d require from our installed panels. Would recommend to anyone looking at getting solar, super affordable for the quality.
From start to finish Every SA has been brilliant in ever aspect! 10 out of 10. Definitely recommend
Quoting was good and quick. Not pushy. Very factual.Install team was great.This is my 3rd solar set up and all have been pretty good.  this was a touch better across the board though.
Energy SA have been efficient,  polite, helpful and on time. The system was install well and is so far doing exactly what they said it would.

The process of quote to installation was very quick. The quote was good value.We have a tricky roof with some shading but I was determined to get solar.The team know what they are talking about. We ended up choosing Enphase microinverters.There was no such thing as too may questions! Phone calls or emails were always welcome. When agreeing to the quote and installation, I knew what I was getting, how it would be installed and what to expect in returns. They summarised the process very well. The follow up and administration was exceptional.The installation was complete in a day. The explanation on how to use the monitoring system was good. The team was polite, friendly and efficient. Everything appears at a high quality and I have confidence in the work.
The whole process was seamless, from the first engagement through to installation and commissioning. I was feeding into the grid the moment the system was turned on. Everything ran like clockwork

Was really happy with the entire process from start to finish. Sam was knowledgeable and not at all pushy. The installation was right on time, and even finished early. Best of all was the fact that EnergySA artfully navigated the arcane process of getting my installation hooked up to the grid and transferred to a retailer. I have no hesitation recommending EnergySA.

Sam went above and beyond to answer all our questions and made the whole process painless. The team that did the install were polite and professional. The admin staff have been extremely helpful. I would absolutely recommend Energy SA.

The sales quoting process was easily understood especially because Robby Mack anticipated our questions and provided just the right amount of detail to clearly explain what was covered in the quote.The installation team was punctual and -  they explained exactly what they would be doing, answered our questions, were polite, and cleaned up as soon as they finished. Before leaving they explained exactly what they had done and gave us the opportunity to ask questions.Customer service is excellent - and yes they are providing support with the grid connection.
everything went according to planno issues anywherehappy with service

Got a phone call from Energy SA pretty quickly. Received a quote via email in detail. Fired lots of questions when he came to discuss about the quote. He's very knowledgeable and answered all of them.Installation went very smoothly. They were punctual, polite, friendly and explained the process well.Customer service after via email is good. They organised grid connection prior to installation but my energy company could not find it so Energy SA resend the application immediately.Also provide support with solar energy production. We are very happy!

EnergySA were very impressive. Highly professional. Great information given by Robby Mack and team. Background work done with minimal fuss. Had to have major upgrade of meter and rerouting of electrical box and electricians did the job efficiently. Assisted with co-ordination of all the necessary parties and follow-up.

Sam (Sales Representative) was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. He was also very patient, answering endless questions. We had to troubleshoot a few details prior to committing to installing, and Sam was quick to think outside the square to help us make progress.Installation day went smoothly, and the result on the roof is neat. The installers were punctual, and courteous.All paperwork and connection was handled by EnergySA, and our system was up and running the next day after installation was completed. Very efficient!!After installation, there was a little hiccup with Solar Analytics program set up, and communication with the office (Stacey) and with Sam was easy and without delays.All up: happy customers!

Sam was very informative and helpful with the quote.All the Installers were very polite. They arrived on the dates pre arranged and left their work siteas they found it.Energy SA organised the grid connection which was all completed within 3 days

From consultation to installation everything has been organised and efficient. Robby explained the choices and process clearly, arranged for the meter box to be changed and timing and paperwork couldn’t have been easier and stress free. The system we decided on is in the mid range so will prove its worth over time. We would thoroughly recommend Energy SA for their reliability and expertise.

Having got multiple quotes from solar providers I chose EnergySA. Their quote was detailed, with multiple options. Sam was punctual, polite and very helpful taking me through everything step-by-step. I was lucky enough to get a cancellation so my installation was very quick. The installation team arrived on time, were very polite and tidied up after themselves - everything you could wish for from tradies! Stacey provided me with excellent customer service including helping me with co-ordinating with my electricity supplier which, due to COVID-19, was sending calls to Manilla! All-in-all a very positive experience and I would not hesitate in recommending EnergySA to anyone else.
EnergySA was a great company to deal with. Polite, easy to deal with. Good price as well.

Purchased a 10kW solar system with micro inverters in July 2020 from Energy SA. Salesman (Robby Mack) was great - friendly, professional and knowledgeable. Energy SA was the only solar company that actually came to our site and looked at it in real life, not quoting from a google maps image.Robby considered our requirements and provided multiple quotes at our request so we could review numerous options, and then followed up promptly to answer questions in detail.  In the end, they were not the cheapest solar quote but we are confident we have the best system for our needs with quality components.  The adminstration was perfect from Lisa and Stacey and we were kept well informed during the process. Installation was perfect - friendly, polite, professional team of 3 guys who arrived on time and finished the job within a day without fuss and cleaned up after themselves.  We are still waiting for the electricity provider to install the meter before we can turn on the system but we can already monitor consumption with the Enphase Enlighten website and that is enlightening in itself!I highly recommend Energy SA if you value high quality, good communication and great customer service.

The entire process was easy and hassle free. Paul gave several good quotes and after the selection Martin and the team did an excellant job is putting everything togather. I am very happy with the service and the final product.

After shopping numerous Solar Companies EnergySA gave advice which saved future problems as other Companies just wanted to sell a Solar System.  I already have Solar and just added a battery and needed extra panels. This Company explained what was needed as I recently obtained a Battery charger not an Inverter and needed an additional one. They access numerous Inverters and panels so after extensive research I obtained a system and they came up with the best price and after signing the system was installed within a month. Everything went smoothly and all working well. Other Companies were trying to sell their system that they had obtained a good price even though it was a low rated system. Most of the Solar panels are Tier One but they rate from the best to the bottom of the pile.

An extremely professional business who I highly recommend. Robby did an amazing job designing a solar system for a complex roof, the administration was very smooth thanks to the girls in the office who kept everything moving and the actual installation was seamless. The follow up support has been great. This is a business who genuinely cares for their customers and provides an extremely high quality product and service.
Excellent processQuote received within 24hrsThanks installed 3 weeks laterSystem active two weeks later

Sam came and quoted the solar instalment. After other quotes, SA Energy, were more on the ball, knew their trade well and I felt safe.The instalment was quick and easy, done in a day.Stacey in the office has been patient and generous with her time to help me thru understanding how it all worksGreat team!

From start to finish could not ask for better experience.Quoting was relaxed, informative without any pressure.Installation of Air Conditioners and Solar was efficient, neat, on time and all the tradesmen where very pleasant and easy to deal with.
Very easy dealings had to modify size and were quick in response.Everything ran on time and installers were helpful in questions asked and left site as found, clean.Would highly recommend
Friendly and reliable installers. Very good office staff  coorrdinated all approvals. It was easy and painless. I recommend them.
The salesman was informative and not pushy, happy to answer any questions.  The installers were on time, hard working and polite.  The whole process was easy and their customer service was excellent.

Right from the outset of working with Energy SA the process has been a delight. All the staff, clerical and technical alike, absolutely own their jobs exhibiting their knowledge, skills and attitude in a friendly and professional manner throughout the whole process.I have no hesitation with recommending the company for solar panel installations and believe that all their services would be supplied with the same excellent candor.Well done all!

I was impressed with the explanation of what the salesman considered the best system for me.  I was also impressed with one other company that gave me a quote.  In the end it had to get down to price.  Unfortunately energy sa  were very disorganized in doing the installation.   It was done over four different days.

The sales and quoting process was thorough and professional. Easy to understand. Well demonstrated. Focus on quality products that will work for a given situation.Installation process was likewise very professional, efficient and thorough. All seemlessly coordinated with electrician.Customer service was terrific - very seamless and EnergySA liaised directly with SAPN.

Quite often, with the vast number of solar companies offering all sorts of deals, it's hard to know who to trust. Trust Energy SA !.Sam quoted our system and laid out all the options and was able to answer any questions on the fly. Very knowledgeable. Others focused on the downside of fly by nighters or persistently negative about the pitch of the roof (in our case). Sam addressed those issues without fuss but that was all.Peter got the preliminaries sorted with the minimum of fuss and was mindful of the little things that a home owner finds important.Robby called to give news of a reasonably lengthy delay with installation and despite my measured disappointment did an excellent job of rearranging schedules to get as close to back on track as he could.Martin, Louis & Peter got the job done with good nature and consideration and had the system running within a week of start date. (With a slight delay for weather)And finally, Stacey & Lisa, although unseen in the process, made sure that all the admin side was efficiently and promptly dealt with.We would not recommend anyone else. Brilliant service and workmanship from start to finish.

Every person that we dealt with in the installation process (initial salesperson, office staff, roof preparer, installer, electrician) was friendly, punctual and professional. We are happy with the installation and confident that if we need any after sales support, we will be dealt with in the same way.
Everthing was easy.. I was having a small bit of trouble with the wifi connection and they responded to assist in getting it setup instantly..such a great team all round.
Difficult site and two roof pitches one 45'. Whole team was supportive and well organised. They kept me in the loop throughout the whole process.Very happy.

Very smooth from quote to install. Only company to provide multiple quotes covering a range of products and price ranges. Installers did a great job - recommending a slightly different panel layout based on shading concerns. From quote to install in ~ 3 weeks without a hassle.
Arrived when they said they would. Very professional, friendly and clean work. Couldnâ€™t believe how quick they were able to install once quote was accepted.

Couldn't be happier with the whole installation process! I was offered a few quotes to choose from and was able to choose a price and system that suited my needs. All the work was done promptly and all questions answered. The only issue I had was getting the WiFi inverter to setup with my phone so I could monitor the system, but sorted that out. Thanks to all involved.

I recently had solar panels added to my townhouse by Energy SA. Robby was great as he attended my premises and gave me a detailed account of the job. Once sorted his installation people did a great job and were on time. Furthermore, the admin staff were fantastic as well. Always kept me updated and nothing was too much trouble.

Its very hard to positively decide what is best value.  Everybody says their panels and inverter are the best.  We have gone with a Zeversolar with a 10 year warranty.  According to EnergySA they have had very good experience with the latest model and back it up themselves for 10 years.  They say Fronius is a lot more expensive and doesn't have as good a warranty as they offer on the Zevesolar.  Others say Zeversolar are cheap and nasty with a 5 year return to Zeversolar for repair and we should buy Fronius.  Time will tell.My old Areosharpe 1.5KW still works after 8 years and most died years ago!  Most agree Jinko are good value and we are getting 230W Black framed ones which at least seem to be the latest and a good choice.Sam, the consultant from Energy SA,  has been very helpful and patient with us.  I am a fussy customer and want it as I want it and needed to research and understand everything about it before I would commit.  The system is going to be located in 3 locations, 2 of which are slightly north of East facing and one slightly west of North.  It is not the easiest and probably not the best for solar collection.  All in a row on the west roof would be easy but part of my specification is I didn't want to see them from the front of the house
Just waiting for origin ever to come tomorrow to do meter work etc then we who be operational

Would definitely recommend this company, we had very little knowledge of solar power or systems but they made it very easy to choose by going through everything with us.There was no "hard sell" as in another company we received a quote from and we could not fault anyone from sales, office or installation. Also installers were great and did a very good job of cleaning up after!First contacted Energy SA on 21st January and everything, including meter change, completed by 14th February. Well done all.

Do the shop around but make sure you compare apples with apples. Make sure you understand the products as this will get you on the same page as the sellers.Energy SA is the way to go.Brilliant from sales to installer to follow up. 10/10.

We do not have our solar system installed yet. We are still waiting on the installer who have nominated the 19th December for the install. That will be approximately 7 weeks since we signed the contract. Our energy provider, origin have already changed over the meter. Additionally, the installer has taken a while to get back to our queries. This is why we have rated the customer service average.
Not installed yet!

Fantastic service and workmanship. The whole installation process was smooth and well organised. We are well informed of the estimated time frame and what to expect. Robby is highly professional and customer focused. We had some issue with power points after installation and when I texted Robby re the issue, he responded immediately - though it was late at night, he turned up and rectify the problem for us. Highly knowledgeable and fantastic customer service ! Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.

Joe the installer was a good person to deal with although there were some problems from his workers. One of them fell through the laundry ceiling which Joe had repaired.At the moment I have a problem with my neighbour who has had minor damage done to her wall next to where the workers were. I am currently talking to Energy SA to try to get my neighbours wall repaired.

EnergySA were recommended to us through word of mouth. We cannot fault the service provided, from the initial in home quote, installation and interaction with admin staff required throughout.EnergySA have provided exceptional customer service and we would go out of our way to recommend them to other South Australian families.
Superb service and highly recommended. Not the cheapest but I feel the best system and honest service
Recently had a solar system installed by Energy SA and i am very happy with the installation and sales,i will recommend this company they did a great job.

QCell panels with EnPhase microinverters. From first discussion to final installation , Robby kept us informed. Once meter was changed over, Install was arranged in the next week and it just happened. Panels installed on E,N and W facing roof. No mess left after. Great real time app to monitor system.Happy to recommend.

Our experience was fantastic from getting the quote all the way through to the installation process.The whole team was always helpful to answer any questions...very approachable.I will be happily recommending Robbie to all my friends.

Of the many who had quoted before them, we chose to proceed with EnergySA, not just because they were fantastically priced, but because they took the time to listen to our needs. They offered sensible and grounded advice, helping to explain the pros and cons of different technologies and recommended the most efficient solution possible.They're approachable, knowledgable and experienced; the kind of people you'd hope to work with in the long term.

All 3 suppliers made contact promptly and quoted on same product brands which were to the top end and to my request. However they all quoted different panel numbers from 15 to 23 which resulted in a range of prices.Whilst all three made initial phone contact only one requested a site visit at the same time to view where to instal and discuss the quote. Whilst we are still working to installation we have found the EnergSA team to be meeting our expectations as to service and provision of information.

We obtained 9 quotes in total. Three from this site. Robby Mack was the only one to actually get on the roof and accurately measure up to ensure the system would fit. His service was second to none. His workmen were friendly efficient and willing to answer any questions.I knew before I obtained any quote what inverter and what panels I wanted. Robby did not try and talk me into inferior equipment at higher prices like a few of the others.Very pleased with EnergySA and would recommend them above many others.
Great service and very friendly. Installation went very smoothly. Great job ,Thanks guys.
Technicians installing Solar tidied area or all packing prior to finishing work - Electrician was extremely helpful explaining the system - Highly recommend

I was very impressed with the EnergySA owner/salesperson, Robby, when he came over to discuss what type and size Solar panel system would suit our current and future needs.  His knowledge and explanations were excellent and quite easy to understand.The EnergySA installation crew were very friendly and worked thoroughly to get the work completed.  We are very happy with our new Solar panels and would highly recommend EnergySA.

System added was  GCL-P6/60 panels (20 X 275W = 5.5 Kw) and using Enphase Envoy-S to monitor solar usage,production, export, etc.This was added to existing Kaneka Panels (20 X 60W = 1.2 Kw) installed in March 2009

The quality of service up to, and including, installation was first class.The people installing the system worked all day in trying conditions, but were informative and courteous throughout the day.I would strongly recommend this supplier.
Energy SA provided excellent equipment along with good service willing to listen and understand our requirements both before, during and after installation.

Out of a total of 6 quotes (2 from this site, one was a "no show"), we selected EnergySA because the manager, Robby, had and unlimited readiness to spend any amount of time discussing and explaining every aspects of the system, the installation, issues we were facing, etc. He, along with each of the tradies that came out, had an obvious seriousness and commitment to meet our needs and install the best system for us. Robby himself requoted our installation at least half a dozen times as our understanding and needs evolved. Unlike one of the quoters from this site, he was ready to listen -- actually listen -- to our needs and design a system specifically for us (one of the quoters from this site continually ignored our requests and kept trying to convince us we wanted some other system that he had obviously pre-designed).We have a less than optimum roof situation and significant partial shading issues. We also had specific objectives to be able to run a large air-conditioner during summer without importing energy, and a few other requirements such as leaving room for the gutters to be cleaned. All of these were attended to and our needs completely satisfied in as much as the situation would allow. The system has been operational for two months, and is working beautifully, in fact is exceeding our expectations.We also had an unfortunate warranty situation with one of the key components of our system. After weeks of stuffing around, the manufacturer declared there was no issue, which was ridiculous. EnergySA at this point took the warranty matter into their own hands. Swapped out the faulty device (an expensive one) and did some additional installation work ... all at their own expense! They say they will continue to chase the warranty situation with the manufacturer, but didn't want us to be dragged through any more. Now there is some serious customer service to you.It is impossible for me to recommend EnergySA highly enough.
Not installed yet, but the customer service has been very good and all questions answered swiftly.

I dealt with Robby from Energy SA and he made the whole experience easy and pleasant. We had some issue with the energy retailer changing the meter over but Robby gave me all the information I needed and what their issue was to get the issue resolved quickly.Very happy with the system and the service.Would definitely use them again

It hasn't been installed yet, as we are waiting for SA power networks to isolate street power so the fuse box can be relocated (or something). This will take some time. However the communication from energy SA has been good. System should be installed within the next few months hopefully.

Paul/Robbie and their team were fantastic to deal with. If only all tradesman were like them and their team. Really happy with our Fronius 4KW Solar and 12.5KW Daikin A/C.  Side by side with the other electricians these guys are top notch.

I got 8 quotes, including the 3 you sent me. I selected EnergySA because I was impressed by the manager Robby's readiness to spend any amount of time discussing/explaining any aspects of the issue, as well as his seriousness and personal committment to meet our needs. We have a tricky roof situation and wanted to have the most efficient distribution of panels.  He initially gave us a proposal, but through our discussions, changed the system (from string to individually optimised panels) the panels (to Qcells) the inverter (to Solar Edge).Robby took his ladder and went on the roof to measure exactly whether the distribution of panels on 3 sides would work. In a sense the project became a joint collaboration. Being qualified and CEC accredited electrician, he gave me the impression of a person with a passion for solar power rather than merely a salesman. His team were also very competent, efficient, thorough, friendly and happy to answer in detail everyone of my questions. Hardly a couple of hours after the end of the installation Robby rang me and offered to have a look at the finished job, and then came around, took his ladder and was again on the roof inspecting the finished job. Everything went smoothly and efficiently. Three days after the installation we had a hailstorm with hailstones the size of chicken's eggs. My wife's car had her back window smashed and roof pockmarked with hail impact. I worried about the newly installed panels. At the end of the storm, the monitoring panel showed all panels to be working at optimal capacity, as they have now for the last week since. The price was very competitive compared to equivalent quotes, about $1000 less than a quote with also a Solar Edge inverter, but with Sunpower panels, and also $1000 less than an equivalent quote withan EnPhase system. At this stage I can recommend EnergySA without reservations. I still keep my fingers crossed that we don't get too many hailstorms like last week though!Kind regardsRene

One of only two companies (out of 6 companies that I requested quotes from) that actually came to site to ensure the quote was accurate and there were no issues.Robby and his team kept my wife and I informed with every part of the installation.  When onsite they were professional and cleaned up.  The system has been ticking along without fault for 4 years and we are happy to go back to them for our plans to go Hybrid in the next 6 months.
Great outcome for my needs. Top job Energy SA.
I would recommend Energy SA as there were more competitive & friendly with a better range of quality components on offer.

EnergySA don't have a shop front to visit and view products, so looking at the system's panels/ inverter was only possible via the internet. The process of signing over STC's wasn't discussed until after installation. No follow up as yet from the office to check on how the installation went a week ago. The system seems to be working very well at the moment with a highest production reading of 75kw on one day (Trina panels and Samil SolarLake inverter).

The sale person gave me 5 different options on panel brands and inverters which I took the time to look over and picked the best to suit my needs. Install was on time and found the workers pleasant, knowledgeable, tidy and they did a great job.Early indication looks good on system performance.I Would recommend them.
